title: Medicare Part D Benefit Information Tracking and Reporting
canonicalText:
[[PA.9001 | Medicare Part D Benefit Information Tracking and Reporting | Applies to: PACE | Revised 06/01/2024]]
<<page 1>>
I. PURPOSE
This policy describes the tracking process by which CalOptima Health Program of All-Inclusive Care for the
Elderly (PACE) documents Participants’ True Out-Of-Pocket (TrOOP) Cost and Part D gross covered drug
costs (GCDC) during enrollment and disenrollment.
II. POLICY
A. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) Part D regulations require CalOptima Health PACE
  organizations to track a Participant’s TrOOP and GCDC and apply these costs to the TrOOP and benefit
  limits in order to place the Participant in the correct phases and provide the catastrophic level of
  coverage at the appropriate time after disenrollment.
B. TrOOP threshold and GCDC are calculated on an annual basis and must be transferred between Part D
  plans if a Participant disenrolls and re-enrolls at any time before the end of the coverage year.
C. For Participants disenrolling from CalOptima Health PACE and enrolling in another Part D plan,
  CalOptima Health PACE will report the TrOOP-related data to the Participant in a Transfer EOB
  document to convey to their subsequent plan sponsor.
D. The Transfer EOB must be created even if the Participant did not have any CalOptima Health PACE
  plan Part D claims activity during the coverage year.
III. PROCEDURE
A. Disenrollment Procedure
  1. CalOptima Health PACE Social Work Department shall review the weekly transaction reply reports
    to identify receipt of any disenrollment transactions with a transaction reply code of [014] or [015]
    indicating that a Participant has disenrolled, the disenrollment information will then be provided to
    CalOptima Health PACE Pharmacy Management.
  2. Upon receipt of the transaction reply report, CalOptima Health PACE Pharmacy Management shall
    initiate the process to create a Transfer EOB in order to transfer the TrOOP balance and the gross
<<page 2>>
    GCDC, if any, to the Participant’s new plan of record. CalOptima Health PACE Pharmacy
    Management shall:
    a. Compute the Participant’s CalOptima Health PACE-only GCDC; and
    b. Enter the CalOptima Health PACE-only GCDC into the Dual Eligible CalOptima Health PACE
      TrOOP Calculator to determine the CalOptima Health PACE TrOOP amount.
  3. CalOptima Health PACE Pharmacy Management shall mail a Transfer EOB document to the
    Participant, indicating the TrOOP balance and GCDC within seven (7) calendar days of receipt of
    the disenrollment transaction reply report.
  4. CalOptima Health PACE Pharmacy Management shall retain copies of Transfer EOB notices sent to
    Participants.
V. REFERENCE(S)
A. “Dual-eligible CalOptima Health PACE Plan Member Accumulated True Out-Of-Pocket Cost
  Calculator,” available at /https://www.cms.gov/apps/troopcalculator/PACE_Calculator.xls
B. Medicare Prescription Drug Manual- Chapter 14 Coordination of Benefits
C. CalOptima Health PACE Program Agreement
D. Title 42, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), §§ 423.104 and 423.464
<<page 4>>
IX. GLOSSARY
Participant: An individual enrolled in the CalOptima Health PACE program.
Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE): PACE is a long-term comprehensive health care program that helps older adults to remain as independent as possible. PACE coordinates and provides all needed preventive, primary, acute and long-term care services so seniors can continue living in their community.
True Out-Of-Pocket (TrOOP) Cost: True out-of-pocket (TrOOP) costs are the payments that count toward a Part D beneficiaries’ Medicare drug plan out-of-pocket threshold. TrOOP costs determine when a beneficiaries’ catastrophic coverage will begin.
